analysis.triageSummary: The alert indicates a brute force attempt targeting the SSH service (sshd) on a local system. No evidence of successful authentication or lateral movement is present in the provided telemetry, but the attempt is confirmed by the rule trigger.

analysis.recommendedImmediateAction: Block the source IP 198.51.100.23 at the perimeter firewall and verify if any successful logins occurred from this IP in the preceding hours.
